notes.title: Shutting Down
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone.

We regret to inform you that Two Man Army Games is shutting down, and so we will be retiring .EXE as a result. We would like to thank you for all of the support you have shown us throughout the years. It has been a wonderful experience for us, and we couldn't have done it without you. 

Cheers,

Two Man Army Games.

notes.title: Community Update Out!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25345916/c98581ddb652ad823cfa756a0aa27c79e9fc552d.png[/img]
Hello Everyone!

We have just pushed out our in-game level editor as well as Steam Workshop access to share your level creations! 

We will continue to add more and fix up the editor as time goes on, but we will do our best not to ruin any of the created files in the meantime.

We are interested in what you will come up with, and keep an eye out for our next major update!

Cheers,

Two Man Army Games

notes.title: Level Editor Announcement!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25345916/c98581ddb652ad823cfa756a0aa27c79e9fc552d.png[/img]

Hey Everyone!

We are glad to announce our next update, which will include beta access to an in-game level editor to create and share your level creations through the Steam Workshop. We will continue to work on making improvements on it, hopefully not ruining any of the created files in the process. You are also free to create and play your own levels locally if you don't feel like sharing. 

We will be releasing the update soon, so prepare to unleash your [strike] inner sadist[/strike] creativity onto the world. 

Cheers,

Two Man Army Games
